name: Shethar-bozenai
bio: Shethar-bozenai, a Persian official, came with Tatnai the governor and their associates to question the Jews rebuilding the Jerusalem temple, asking who had authorized it. He joined Tatnai in sending King Darius a detailed letter about the project rather than stopping it outright (Ezra 5:3-17). They complied at once once Darius's decree arrived, and the temple was finished in his sixth year (Ezra 6:13-15).
